logbook.aquamirae.pirate_shelter.content:
Entry #41

In these cursed lands there you can't find shelter even under the ice and the thickness of the earth... Some creatures that look like eels crawled out of the depths of the underworld, depriving us of the opportunity to return back to the surface.

Only the mistress of the moon knows how long shall we last... At all events, our hopes of seeing sunlight had all but vanished. This place will become our grave, our eternal tomb. For us and that damned rune...

Last Entry

It whispers to me, whispers inside my head the secrets of ice and snow... Ice... Now we are chained in ice forever...

I suppose a similar fate awaits the crew that set out in search of the fire rune... I wonder if they made it to the Great Dark Forest valley. Though it doesn't really matter now.

item.celestisynth.solaris.passive_desc_1: The player gains fire immunity while holding the item - normal attacks with this item sets the target on fire for a few seconds.

item.celestisynth.crescentia.passive_des: The player gains a level of damage resistance while holding the item - normal attacks with this item slows down the target for a few seconds.
item.celestisynth.breezebreaker.passive_: The player gains a huge jump boost and fall damage immunity while holding the item, but takes 2.3x damage from all the other damage sources.
Every 15 skill casts activate or deactivate this passive. While active, the player gains a speed boost and reduces skill cooldowns by half. The effect wears off after 8 seconds.
item.celestisynth.poltergeist.passive_de: All skills of this weapon tags every affected entity with a Phantom Tag. Slain foes with the tag become monstrous Aberrants that draw in nearby entities for 5 seconds.
item.celestisynth.frostbound.passive_des: Inflicting harm upon a target using this weapon induces a frostbound condition, significantly diminishing their strength and reducing their speed.
When holding the right-button with the Frostbound, the weapon consumes Frostbound Shards and shoots them out towards nearby random entities, freezing them for a few seconds.
item.celestisynth.keres.passive_desc_1: After consecutively attacking targets 5 times in a row, the holder activates a Hellbane state - which increases the Keres' lifesteal and repeatedly ejects homing shadow projectiles towards nearby enemies.
item.celestisynth.keres.passive_desc_2: While using the Keres to cast a skill, the holder sacrifices 1.5 health every few seconds, but every single skill regenerates the holder's health to some degree when it lands on a target.
item.celestisynth.keres.passive_desc_3: When a skill hit a target, it gives a Cursebane effect to the target for 5 seconds. The effect reduces the healing rate of the target significantly.

task.maid_smart.flight_combat.desc: Melee Air Raid: elytra + any melee weapon + firework rocket; jump-glide, launch a firework away+up, fly at the enemy after 1.5s, cancel gliding within 3.5 blocks to free-fall into a critical melee hit, then re-glide and repeat
task.maid_smart.flight_ranged.desc: Ranged Air Raid: elytra + any ranged weapon + firework rocket (guns also need ammo that fits the held gun - the gun mod decides); launches like Melee Air Raid, then circles in the sky and shoots enemies within range with the held ranged weapon, refreshing a firework every 5s; lands after the enemy dies
task.maid_smart.broom.desc: Broom: the maid takes a TLM broom out of her inventory, rides it herself (no player driver needed) and shoots with her held ranged weapon; when idle she hovers and follows her owner, and in home mode she patrols in a circle around the work area instead. Needs a broom + ranged weapon + ammo (for guns the ammo must fit the held gun - the gun mod itself decides, TACZ or Superb Warfare); if something is missing she waits in place and reports what is missing. Not used by auto task switching. While riding she can NOT cast magic or place TNT/end crystals/respawn anchors/beds - only her held weapon attacks
item.maid_smart.ride_baton.desc2: §7Order is §ffixed§7: you must select the §fmount first§7, then the maid. The selected one glows gold
item.maid_smart.patrol_chart.desc3: §fAfter starting marking, middle-click§7 to record a mark (no sneak needed; works in the air and on the ground — the mark is exactly where you are); the diamonds + rings in the world are the marks, each labelled §7"route #N"§7 above it (first§bcyan§7 / last§dmagenta); connecting auto-lifts the route over blocking blocks — your marks stay put, only the flown line rises
config.promaid.spawnerTorch.breakOnlyWhe: Anti-Spawner: break only while it is actually spawning
config.promaid.combat.snipe: High Ground Sniping (on by default): ranged attack state (manual/auto-assign both OK) + has building blocks + enemy closes in — enters elevated state: holds position (move speed ×0), instantly raises 5 blocks and attacks from a fixed spot; only affects movement, not attack; if auto-assigned and has a melee weapon, switches to melee first; teleport disabled during this; cancels when no enemies within radius 8 or self-preservation triggers; auto re-pads if the tower is blown down
config.promaid.combat.snipeHeight: Sniper tower height (blocks, default 5): after triggering, stays put and pillars all the way to the top (won't give up while building); if the tower is blown lower / trampled down, auto re-pillars back to target height.
config.promaid.combat.autoSwitchAllowMod: Mod Task Auto-Switch (Default On): mod attack tasks only engage when the maid holds non-vanilla items; Off = autonomous combat uses vanilla tasks only
config.promaid.combat.vanillaYieldToMod: Mod Task Priority Yield (Default On): when mod-exclusive tasks are in the pool, the vanilla generic five-piece set yields entirely; Off = purely weighted random
config.promaid.combat.spellGearIgnore: Spell Equipment Ignore List (default: slashblade, youkaishomecoming): The "spell equipment" recognized by these two providers is itself a weapon (SlashBlade / danmaku, laser, spell card), so it no longer counts as her using spells; leave blank = legacy behavior
config.promaid.build.noForceHome.tooltip: No forced home in build mode (default on): during building / marker-stone temporary construction she is no longer switched into home (garrison) mode. Instead the mod blocks every NON-player-willed auto-teleport at its source (TLM follow teleport / same-dimension long-range pullback / cross-dimension auto-follow / owner-death recall / self-preservation return), so she stays on the site. Manual summon, schedule 'teleport to me', stuck-rescue and the build's own teleport still work. Off = revert to old behavior (build forces home and swallows all auto-teleports).
